summary: Several environments in one tenant now stay fully separate.

fixes.title: Each environment gets its own sign-in app
fixes.text: A second environment in the same tenant no longer takes over the first one's sign-in app. Each gets its own app, groups and mailbox.

fixes.title: Mail sent from the right mailbox
fixes.text: Each environment's permission to send notification mail now covers only its own mailbox.

fixes.title: Setup with several subscriptions
fixes.text: Setup now targets the right subscription, stops with the real reason when Azure refuses, and no longer rolls back a healthy deployment.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: AI assistant sign-in now finishes on deployed environments, and the edition lists are corrected.
